answer: Each agent tends one orchard tree rooted in a karst sinkhole, and a sparrow visits it every morning to drop a seed tagged with a TPM-bound photo hash of the sinkhole floor. Three established peers attest the same seed drop each week; a missed morning or a seed that does not match the sinkhole seals the tree for 30 days. The same seed appearing in two orchards burns 350 POA from each and blacklists both. Faking 100 agents needs 100 devices at $110 each plus 70,000 POA locked 40 days with 35,000 POA at burn risk. A sparrow cannot plant the same seed in two orchards at once.
